text:
- **Go pm is the only implementation:** Python pm is deleted from the pm repo and from yeeef-agents. The harness suite now tests only Go pm. The Linux server's clone runs Go pm and syncs with GitHub again.
- **Release and changelog:** A Go pm release is published as a minor version, because main has a breaking change. Every release now has a structured release note. CI refuses a change without one.
- **Site reads on phones:** Wide diagrams now scroll sideways on a phone, and images kept beside a record now show. The site no longer shows missing-file errors while git rewrites the records.
- **Worktrees and records:** pm clean removes agent worktrees that nobody needs. It previews removals first. pm no longer writes a copy of the records into main; each worktree keeps a link instead.
